listening.title: Monthly report meeting with the director

lines.speaker: Linh (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Good afternoon. I will present the August report in about ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Minh (Operations Director)
lines.text: Please keep the summary short and clear.

lines.speaker: Linh (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Of course. Revenue reached fifteen billion dong, and our gross margin improved slightly.

lines.speaker: Minh (Operations Director)
lines.text: That sounds positive. What about our costs?

lines.speaker: Linh (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Total operating expense was higher than plan, mainly because of new software licences.

lines.speaker: Minh (Operations Director)
lines.text: So we had some overspending in the IT budget?

lines.speaker: Linh (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Yes. Slide four shows budget versus actual for every department.

lines.speaker: Minh (Operations Director)
lines.text: Can you explain the biggest difference there?

lines.speaker: Linh (Finance Manager)
lines.text: The variance analysis points to two items: licences and overtime payments.

lines.speaker: Minh (Operations Director)
lines.text: Is the licence fee a recurring cost or a single payment?

lines.speaker: Linh (Finance Manager)
lines.text: It is a recurring cost, so I added it to the next quarter forecast.

lines.speaker: Minh (Operations Director)
lines.text: Good. Round the figures on the summary slide; we can zoom in on the details later.
